summary: Lisata Therapeutics disclosed via Form 8-K an amendment to its March 6, 2026 merger agreement with Kuva Labs Inc. (Parent) and Kuva Acquisition Corp., extending the outside date from July 17 to July 21, 2026. Parent and Purchaser have commenced a tender offer for Lisata shares, for which Lisata filed a Schedule 14D-9 recommendation statement. No price per share, premium, or advisor names are stated in this filing. The brief extension signals imminent closing; the key watchpoint is whether all conditions (including regulatory and shareholder tender) are satisfied by July 21, creating a narrow risk-arb window requiring monitoring of tender results.
